capabilities.justification: Default Ollama endpoint. The A/B demo dials a local Ollama instance to run the raw model arm and the pipeline arm. The user can override the endpoint via ADJ_DEMO_ENDPOINT for a different host:port.
Demo also supports a non-localhost Ollama (set via ADJ_DEMO_ENDPOINT) for users running the model on another machine on their LAN.
OllamaClient resolves the endpoint host (via ToSocketAddrs) before connecting. Required even for 127.0.0.1 on some platforms.

justification: Binary demo that talks to a locally-running Ollama instance and prints a side-by-side report. Net + env + stdout are the only OS surfaces it touches. The library half (used by tests) has zero OS access; only the binary needs these capabilities.
